description: Return current pricing state or a non-charging quote. Never executes or charges.

capabilityId.description: The R/IV capability ID this call is about, for example claim.check.

capability_id.description: Optional alias for capabilityId; identifies the R/IV operation to quote without charging or executing it.

maximumAuthorizedCost.description: Optional maximum cost in USD the caller authorizes for this capability. The quote only reports whether the capability fits within this bound; a pricing quote never charges.

name: pricing.quote
